The open-source AI video editor: create, edit, remake.

Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.

Download the app · Quickstart · Showcase · Catalog · Docs · Discord · X · YouTube

HyperFrames is HeyGen's AI video editor for people and agents. Describe a video, bring your own footage, or remake a video you love, and get a real project you can change down to the frame: ask for a bigger title, a faster cut or new captions, and it changes just that. # HyperFrames v0.9.80

Released on 2026-11-22.

Dropping a clip onto main-track clips can now insert it there. Studio previews match the export more closely, and a drive that stops answering no longer stalls a project.

## Features

- **Studio:** Dropping a clip onto main-track clips can insert it there ([08bd7fc12](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/08bd7fc126b1ae158bc9503672acbd88099c9cab), [#8397](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8397)).

## Fixes

- **Engine:** An asset download fails once when the egress proxy drops its tunnel ([da1476e48](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/da1476e48d701d89187f8236ca9f4fc6b9e12158), [#8417](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8417)).
- **Studio:** An insert on drop never lets linked partners overlap or start before 0 ([8929d1164](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8929d116499e10f06622c701ef54d31637c3aef5), [#8416](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8416)).
- **Studio:** A refused delete no longer brings back another delete still saving ([c1f4a193a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c1f4a193a9e3e72776a1433ba72298f5d38237d4), [#8413](https://github.com/

# HyperFrames v0.9.79

Released on 2026-11-21.

Trimming a main-track clip with Ripple on now closes the gap. Media files that sit outside a project are no longer reused, credited or written through a linked folder.

## Fixes

- **Media Use:** A transcript cut named inside the project is never written through a linked folder ([4e873f5a1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4e873f5a1ded50197845836aa95056dfd8356914), [#8398](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8398)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.78

Released on 2026-11-21.

Undo after an agent step now brings back the files it changed. A catalog gap report on Windows never puts a query your shell would run into a command, and renders sharing one capture proxy keep their connections.

## Features

- **Engine:** A late image's load time is logged when it arrives ([e65b11e5c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e65b11e5c2be2c73d3ab0ea5628c51ec13f68a21), [#8372](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8372)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.77

Released on 2026-11-21.

CLI messages now show control characters as plain text. An undo in Studio never deletes a file another page still uses, and big root previews no longer hold up other requests.

## Features

- **Studio Server:** A host can name paths its project history never records ([9bea44695](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9bea44695b6c36f9eb89542fdeca556750dcc797), [#8224](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8224)).

The open-source AI video editor: create, edit, remake.

Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.

Download the app · Quickstart · Showcase · Catalog · Docs · Discord · X · YouTube

HyperFrames is HeyGen's AI video editor for people and agents. Describe a video, bring your own footage, or remake a video you love, and get a real project you can change down to the frame: ask for a bigger title, a faster cut or new captions, and it changes just that.

Underneath, HyperFrames is a free, open-source framework (Apache 2.0) for turning HTML, CSS, JavaScript, media and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows. No React required.

Three ways to use it

Best for Start
HyperFrames Studio app Anyone, no code. Describe a video or drop in your footage, then edit by typing or pointing. Use the built-in agent on Pro, or your own Claude Code or Codex. Download for Mac, Windows or Linux (free plan)
Your coding agent Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other agents. npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes
Claude, ChatGPT or Grok (beta) Making a video in a chat, nothing to install. ChatGPT: Business, Enterprise and Edu workspaces. Connect HyperFrames by HeyGen, listed in Claude's connector directory

The HyperFrames Studio app has a free plan. Pro ($25 a month) adds top video, image, voice and music models (HeyGen Video 1, Seedance 2.5, Lyria 3 Pro and more) and 25,000 credits a month.

Made with HyperFrames

What you can make

Video How
Branded UGC videos for TikTok and Instagram from your own phone clips: captions, music, text hooks, fast client revisions The Studio app: drop in your footage, then edit by typing or pointing
Video podcast episodes: line up a multi-camera recording, cut to whoever is talking, clean up the sound, add captions The Studio app's podcast edit
Product demos, tutorials, launch videos and feature announcements, from your website or a screen recording Paste your URL into the Studio app, or ask your agent
Explainer and faceless YouTube episodes from your topic, script or voiceover Ask for one; /style-sampling for five proven series styles
Remake a video you love, then make it yours /reverse-any-video
Social videos with kinetic captions, overlays, and music /hyperframes with the catalog
Data visualizations, chart races, and map animations Catalog blocks for charts and maps
PR walkthroughs and changelog videos with animated code diffs, narration, and captions Point your agent at the pull request
Docs-to-video and site-tour explainers Give your agent the document or link
Motion graphics with code instead of After Effects, reusable in automated content pipelines The CLI, cloud render or AWS Lambda
Decks with presenter mode /slideshow
Motion from a Figma file /figma
A Remotion project, ported /remotion-to-hyperframes

By job: AI video editor · animated captions · add text to video · AI motion graphics · HTML to MP4 · Lottie to MP4 · SVG to MP4

Community skills (hyperframes-community-skills, community-maintained, review before use): camera-3d-captions (captions in 3D around a speaker), vox-explainer (collage explainers), p5-paint-animation (handwriting and paint-on), prod-by-claude (live-coded music videos), session-story and day-in-my-life (your agent sessions as films), duo (side-by-side phone memes), x-posting-license (an ID-card video for any X profile).

Quick start for developers

Using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another coding agent? Install the skills once, then ask your agent to make a video.

Give your coding agent the skills (recommended)

npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes     # pick "Core Skills" in the picker
# or, with no picker (scripts, CI):
npx hyperframes skills update

Then try: Using /hyperframes, create a 10-second product intro with a fade-in title, a background video, and subtle background music.

Claude Code plugin

claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes
claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes

Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot

See the plugin guide.

By hand, with the CLI

npx hyperframes init my-video
cd my-video
npx hyperframes preview      # live preview in the browser
npx hyperframes render       # render to MP4

Requirements: Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg. Render in the cloud with hyperframes cloud render, or on your own AWS Lambda.

Skill install options, updates and the core set (full details)

Claude Code plugin updates

To enable auto-update for the hyperframes marketplace, run claude in a terminal in your project. In Claude Code's terminal UI, run /plugin, then select Marketplaces → hyperframes → Enable auto-update. Afterward, use /hyperframes:hyperframes. See the plugin guide for Copilot, VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, updates, and migration.

Standalone skills (including OpenCode)

The picker opens with nothing pre-selected — the Core Skills group is all you need; /slideshow, /remotion-to-hyperframes and /figma install on demand. Without the picker (a script or a CI job), npx hyperframes skills update installs exactly the core set, whereas skills add --all installs all 9 published skills. The six repo-internal skills under .claude/skills / .agents/skills are excluded by default. For the full published set use npx hyperframes skills.

skills add resolves the skills.sh registry blob, which can lag main by hours. npx hyperframes skills update installs the skills from the release tag that matches your CLI version, so they match the CLI that runs them.

Run project-local installs from your video project's directory. From a HyperFrames checkout, use npx hyperframes skills update for a global install instead: a project-local installer target can overlap the tracked skills/ source and overwrite uncommitted edits. See contributor setup.

The skills teach agents the HyperFrames production loop: plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render. They work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, IBM Bob, and other coding agents that support skills.

Share a video for review

Sign in with npx hyperframes auth login, then run npx hyperframes share to choose who can open the rendered review. Use share --update when edits should become a new version and share --manage for web settings. CLI and Desktop use the same sharing system and five free projects per workspace. Existing legacy published links remain reachable.

Skills

HyperFrames ships 9 skills. Make any video by asking for it; the /hyperframes skill carries the contract and the references (film, captions, overlays, motion, look). Read it first.

The core set below is what npx hyperframes skills update installs and what the picker lists as "Core Skills". Install one skill with npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --skill <name>, or all 9 with --all. A non-interactive or agent run of npx skills add without --skill installs all 9. npx hyperframes init adds the core set only when it is missing and never touches a skill you already have; on-demand skills install with npx hyperframes skills update <name>.

Core set

Skill Use when
/hyperframes Read first for any request to make, edit, animate or render a video, motion graphic, captions or overlays with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video). Holds the render contract and the work loop, and points to the references for format, motion, look, captions, whole films and storyboards.
/hyperframes-cli The HyperFrames CLI by job — scaffold, check, look at frames, edit the timeline, preview, render locally or in the cloud, share, project history — plus reading its JSON and recovering from build or render failures.
/hyperframes-registry About 450 ready-made blocks and components installed as editable source — transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, maps, 3D, camera moves. Use before hand-building any named visual; also for hyperframes add and catalog.
/media-use Get or make any media for a video — music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar and generated video, transcripts, cutouts, colour grades and looks — with HeyGen or free local tools, and mix placed audio. Also for footage that looks dark, flat or dull.
/reverse-any-video Rebuilding any video file as an editable HyperFrames project (motion graphics, talking heads, live action, AI-generated footage), checked frame by frame against the original.
/style-sampling Making a new episode on your topic in one of five proven styles: Collage Explainer, Finance Explainer, Animated Science Explainer, 3D Brand Explainer, 3D True Crime.

On demand

Skill Use when
/figma Bring Figma into a video — rendered assets, brand tokens, components, storyboard frames as reconstructed motion, shaders and connector-assisted motion. Use when you paste a figma.com link.
/slideshow A presentation, pitch deck or interactive deck — discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, presenter mode with speaker notes. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
/remotion-to-hyperframes Bringing existing video code or footage into HyperFrames (Remotion first; also Motion Canvas, Lottie, Three.js, canvas, other tools' renders), verified frame by frame.

For visual design handoff workflows, see the Claude Design guide and Open Design guide.

More from the community: hyperframes-community-skills.

Frame.md

frame.md — your design system, ready for video.

Every brand has a design.md. None of them were written for a camera. frame.md is the missing translation layer: it takes your web-context design spec and inverts it for the frame — the same tokens, the same rules, but rewritten so an AI agent can compose a promo video without guessing at scale or reaching for web chrome.

The output is a DESIGN.md superset your whole toolchain can read. Atoms stay sacred. Composition stays free. Numbers come from the script.


Biennale Yellow
BlockFrame

Blue Professional
Bold Poster

Browse and remix them all at hyperframes.studio/design.

How It Works

Define a video as HTML. Add data attributes for timing and tracks. Use GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI, or your own frame adapter for seekable animation.

<div id="stage" data-composition-id="launch" data-start="0" data-width="1920" data-height="1080">
  <video
    class="clip"
    data-start="0"
    data-duration="6"
    data-track-index="0"
    src="intro.mp4"
    muted
    playsinline
  ></video>

  <h1 id="title" class="clip" data-start="1" data-duration="4" data-track-index="1">Launch day</h1>

  <audio
    data-start="0"
    data-duration="6"
    data-track-index="2"
    data-volume="0.5"
    src="music.wav"
  ></audio>

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
    tl.from("#title", { opacity: 0, y: 40, duration: 0.8 }, 1);
    window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
    window.__timelines.launch = tl;
  </script>
</div>

Preview instantly in the browser. Render locally or in Docker. The renderer seeks each frame in headless Chrome and encodes the result with FFmpeg, so the same input produces the same video.

Why HyperFrames?

  • HTML-native: make videos programmatically with HTML, CSS and JavaScript; compositions are HTML files with data attributes. No React requirement, no proprietary timeline format.
  • Agent-friendly: agents already write HTML, and the CLI is non-interactive by default.
  • Deterministic: same input, same frames, same output. Built for CI, regression tests, and automated rendering.
  • No build step: an index.html composition plays as-is and can be previewed directly in the browser.
  • Adapter-based animation: bring GSAP, CSS animations, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI, or a custom runtime.
  • Open source: Apache 2.0 license, with no per-render fees or commercial-use thresholds.

HyperFrames vs Remotion

HyperFrames is inspired by Remotion. Both tools render video with headless Chrome and FFmpeg. The main difference is the authoring model: Remotion's bet is React components; HyperFrames' bet is plain HTML that humans and agents can both write easily.

HyperFrames Remotion
Authoring HTML + CSS + seekable animation React components
Build step None; index.html plays as-is Bundler required
Agent handoff Plain HTML files JSX / React project
Library-clock animations Seekable, frame-accurate via adapters Wall-clock animation patterns need care
Distributed rendering Local and AWS Lambda render paths Remotion Lambda, mature cloud renderer
License Apache 2.0 Source-available Remotion License

Read the full comparison in the HyperFrames vs Remotion guide, or the side-by-side comparison page.

Catalog

Install ready-to-use blocks and components:

npx hyperframes add flash-through-white   # shader transition
npx hyperframes add instagram-follow      # social overlay
npx hyperframes add data-chart            # animated chart

Browse the catalog at hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog.

HyperFrames Stack

HyperFrames is the open-source rendering engine, plus a growing set of tools around HTML-native video creation.

Piece Status What it does
CLI Available Scaffold, preview, lint, inspect, and render local video projects
Core / Engine / Producer Available Parse compositions, drive headless Chrome, encode video, and mix audio
Catalog Available Reusable blocks and components for transitions, overlays, captions, charts, maps, and effects
Agent skills Available Teach coding agents the video-production patterns that generic web docs miss
Browser editor (hyperframes preview) Available, evolving Preview and edit compositions in the browser: canvas, timeline, keyframes
AWS Lambda rendering Available Deploy a distributed render stack and drive renders from your laptop or CI
hyperframes.studio Available The HyperFrames Studio app for Mac, Windows and Linux, plans and community
frame.md Available Invert your design system for the camera — a DESIGN.md superset an agent can compose video from

Packages

Package Description
hyperframes CLI for creating, previewing, linting, and rendering compositions
@hyperframes/core Types, parsers, generators, linter, runtime, and frame adapters
@hyperframes/engine Seekable page-to-video capture engine using Puppeteer and FFmpeg
@hyperframes/producer Full rendering pipeline for capture, encode, and audio mix
@hyperframes/studio Browser-based composition editor UI
@hyperframes/player Embeddable <hyperframes-player> web component
@hyperframes/shader-transitions WebGL shader transitions for compositions
@hyperframes/aws-lambda AWS Lambda SDK and deployment surface for distributed renders

Documentation

Full documentation: hyperframes.heygen.com/introduction

  • Quickstart
  • Showcase
  • Guides
  • API Reference
  • Catalog
  • Examples
  • AWS Lambda rendering

Community

HyperFrames is used in production at HeyGen, with community examples from teams like tldraw, TanStack, and others in ADOPTERS.md. Open a PR if your team is using HyperFrames.

  • Questions and ideas: Discord
  • Bugs and feature requests: GitHub Issues
  • User research: Book a casual 30-minute conversation with the HyperFrames team — no preparation or sales pitch
  • Security reports: SECURITY.md
  • Contributions: CONTRIBUTING.md
  • Follow along: X · YouTube

Development Note

The repo uses Git LFS for golden regression-test baselines under packages/producer/tests/**/output.mp4 (about 240 MB of .mp4 files). If you're cloning the full repo for development, install Git LFS first:

# macOS
brew install git-lfs

# Ubuntu / Debian
sudo apt install git-lfs

# Windows
winget install GitHub.GitLFS

# Then, once per machine
git lfs install

If you only need source files, you can skip LFS content:

GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git

License

Apache 2.0

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open-source framework using HTML, CSS, and seekable animations to programmatically generate deterministic MP4 videos.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: HyperFrames bridges the gap between modern web development and high-quality video production by allowing developers and AI agents to define rich motion graphics using standard web technologies. It orchestrates complex rendering pipelines utilizing Puppeteer and FFmpeg to accurately convert HTML layouts, CSS styling, and precise GSAP animations into highly deterministic, production-ready MP4 files. The framework is heavily optimized for agentic workflows, exposing deep integration skills that teach coding assistants exactly how to plan, layout, animate, and reliably render complete videos from a simple text prompt. By unifying web tech and video encoding, it completely removes the need for complex, manual NLE software when generating massive volumes of automated marketing or explainer content.
keyFeatures: Web-Native Rendering: Generates high-fidelity video files directly from standard HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without requiring proprietary animation software.
Agent-Optimized Skills: Ships with 19 specialized skills designed specifically to teach LLM coding agents how to autonomously plan and orchestrate the video rendering loop.
Deterministic Output: Guarantees frame-perfect accuracy by deeply synchronizing seekable web animations with backend video encoding pipelines.
Dynamic Router System: Employs an intelligent routing skill that dynamically installs only the specific creation workflows required for the requested video type.
Broad Agent Compatibility: Integrates seamlessly via standard MCP and skill protocols with popular coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor.
